title: False Core and the Sea of Devils
summary: Wang Lin is trapped in a formation by a Core Formation cultivator, kills him and takes his golden core. Absorbing a tenth of it lifts him from mid Foundation Establishment to the False Core stage, and Feng Luan gives him the second part of the map. News comes that the Nascent Souls guarding the Country-Locking Formation have been killed and the fire beasts are loose again. Feng Luan's daughter Zhou Zihong, who knows he is not the real Ma Liang, offers him the last map if he kills Xu Si and Zhou An, the pair who betrayed Ma Liang, and he kills them both. Fleeing the fire beasts, he saves Li Muwan of Luo He Sect from a mid Core Formation cultivator of the Dual Cultivation Sect and claims the half-finished Tianli Pill she carries. With her he crosses the border by Earth Escape into the cold, fog-covered Sea of Devils, where the fire beasts cannot follow. There he decides to dig a cave and form his core.
events: A Core Formation cultivator traps Wang Lin in a formation; Wang Lin kills him and seizes his golden core

Feng Luan gives him the second map

Zhou Zihong trades the last map for the deaths of Xu Si and Zhou An; Wang Lin kills them
Wang Lin saves Li Muwan from a Dual Cultivation Sect cultivator and learns she carries a half-finished Tianli Pill
The two flee by Earth Escape into the fog of the Sea of Devils
cultivation: Wang Lin rises from mid Foundation Establishment to the False Core stage (a Foundation Establishment great perfection one step below Core Formation) after absorbing about 10% of a seized golden core. Li Muwan's attacker is at mid Core Formation.
